description: A Trader Joe’s tote bag sits on the right side of the bed, with a pink plush bunny and a small blue toy lying on the left. The right hand reaches to the tote and lifts it while the left hand comes in to help open it; both hands spread the mouth of the bag and rummage inside, then the right hand releases the bag while the left hand moves to the bunny and lifts it (with the blue toy alongside) up toward the open tote to bag it.
